changes.summary: Add durable concurrent provider-cost and request admission with retained reservations for unknown outcomes
Represent uncapped embedding plans separately from application budgets and report refused embeddings without assuming monthly exhaustion
Ship a precompiled universal Vue credit picker and scoped CSS so consumers do not compile package SFCs into colliding client/server output paths.
Add shared credit amount slider and presets with canonical pricing and atomic checkout quote replacement and payment locking.
Add estimate-based background work admission while preserving exact-ID recovery and hard charge caps.
Add bound compare-and-swap checkpoints for deferred credit work without releasing reserved credits.
Transfer reserved credit work to immutable deferred effect authorizations and settle only bound terminal outcomes
Bind serialized ledger, work and checkout JSON as text before casting, preventing PostgreSQL drivers from double-encoding state
Add bounded customer billing reports, receipt cursors and reconciled usage projections
Add single-use purchase-only checkout handoffs with hashed capabilities, account binding and CSRF verification
Add durable prepaid credit accounts, reservations, and capped idempotent work settlement
